answers.explanation: A process is the unit of work within the system.
A program is a file of instructions. A process is those instructions running.
Two browser windows can be two processes from one program.
A process needs CPU, memory, I/O, files, and initialization data.
A multi-threaded process has one program counter per thread.
Each process gets a turn, switched quickly by the scheduler.
Memory, open files, and devices go back to the pool.
Compiling is a job for the compiler, an application.
